 Trusts
 Blind trust administered at arm’s length that was not established for political reasons. I am ordered by the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, as required by paragraph 41.3(1)(b) of the Parliament of Canada Act, not to derive any income from it, including the disbursement of assets, for the purpose of financing a nomination contest, a leadership contest or an electoral campaign established in keeping with the conflict of interest rules.
 Summary Statement
 Obligation to provide a confidential report has been met and all initial reporting and compliance measures have been taken to comply with the Conflict of Interest Act .

 Circumstances
 The ten interns interviewed and chose the MPs they will work with. The interns are university graduates and have received training from the House of Commons prior to starting.
 Recusal
